reports.desc:
As others reported "reading glasses" do not work let alone self adjust as advertised.
Likewise support email does not work.  Phone call answers but they do not honor the 100% refund and charge excessive amount for return and restocking,, offer to settle for partial refund.  Packaging makes no reference to magnification, only blu-light blocking (likely remarketing product fraudulently.).
****** was the payment method , their website reached via YouTube Ad

I have tried for months to initiate a refund but keep getting bot responses. they wont provide a phone number. I have emailed the same refund email provided 20 times and continue to get generic responses. I have asked that they call me. I have asked for any type  of contact and just get a bot response. I have all of the emails.  I want the two shipments of their products to be refunded like I started to request a month ago. the number I provided on the claim form a few pages was mine, I just needed to enter something. They have NO phone number anywhere

The dress purchased is a counterfeit of an image of another dress on another site. The dress I ordered had a raised brocade gold pattern. The dress received is a screen printed athletic pattern. When asked for a refund, told it was the same dress and they would offer a 15% discount as a gesture of good will however their site says full refunds with the exception the buyer pays shipping to China. Buyer beware!

I contacted the company to help me cosign a loan. They then had me sign a contract and pay the fee of $75 to get started. Once I signed the contract and paid the fee, I was blocked on their WhatsApp and Facebook group. I figured this out because I tried contacting them with no success.
Do not trust. Sends Korean booster packs worth much less. Claims 50% off and free gifts. But just bulk.

It was portrayed as being in Savannah, GA but product came from China via California address. I received merchandise but it wasn't as shown, took a month to receive, was very poor quality and didn't fit. Per the advertised money back guarantee, this was not the case. It was not returnable unless I paid additional money for each item and then no promise that it would be refunded to my account. I was told that I would be credited a 25% refund within 3-10 business days. That did not occur and my emails requesting credit have been ignored. This was ordered mid-July, didn't get order till mid-August and still no refund to my Credit Card.  I have attached the communication. They have only used stall tactics and now are not even replying to my request about the refund to my C Card so I am unsure of how to resolve this. Shocking that this could occur when it appeared so reputable.

I received an anonymous call about 6-7 times in less than a minute by 816 area code. I did not know who this person was. She called and her English was not very great and it was about a potential job opportunity and attempted to ask me basic questions to see if I qualify for the job then, after the questions I immediately was given an employee contract form asking about my personal information, my ID and mailing address in my account banking information.

My experience duplicates that of another claim shown on your BBB site TO A TEE.
Placed an order. Original receipt did not match claims of order.. challenged said fee, which was removed.
Placed order July 13, 2026.
Merchant provided tracking information only after I made third reach out
Tracking number into the states was Accurate
Tracking number provided within states was incorrect.
Provided a secondary tracking number which was also incorrect
Claims the tracking numbers belong to USPS
USPS local never was in possession of merchandise
Merchant continued daily argument items were received
Filed claim with PayPal. They received same argument from merchant and closed case without.
I paid shipping insurance for this transaction
Merchant says my claim is with shipper, but provides no assistance in filing claim
Merchant list, BBB accredited, now I find this is an accurate.

Push Button popped up claiming great wealth and once I decided against the purchase, the transaction had already gone through. I tried contacting customer support and am now getting the run around. Redirected back and forth from website to website to no avail.
I ordered a bunch of shirts and never received them and tried to email them and it is a fake email
I ordered shirts from them never received tracking number says it was delivered and I never received it.
